item.title: dotnet: Introducing staged publishing on NuGet.org
item.description:
NuGet.org now supports staged publishing, letting authors upload packages privately, validate them, and approve release later. The post describes this as a new publishing flow for package owners.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: Opt-in dist-tag permissions for npm trusted publishing
item.description:
npm trusted publishing can now optionally get permission to manage dist-tags using short-lived OIDC credentials. This covers actions like moving tags such as latest, next, and beta without using long-lived credentials.

  • Source: GitHub
